Name: Large Greenhouse (PIF)
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

Someone asked for it, so here it is!
Large PIF Greenhouse, the walls and floors can be changed and the walls decorated, it has a lively fountain as a water source, and giant crops are allowed.

[size=3]This is a PIF mod, does not replace the game greenhouse but adds a greenhouse by buying a door, or the decorative ones you can buy from Robin's shop, or from the wizard in the tunnel west of the bus stop, or any other PIF door. I have specially created PIF doors that pair well with my greenhouses or outdoor gardens, which you can find here: [size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28160]Dynamic Glass Doors for PIF Windows and Plants[/url][/size][/size]
[size=3]To enter the greenhouse, you only have to hang the door on a wall and enter the room.[/size]

The fountain was created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/182201142]TangaS2[/url] and animated by me.

Maybe you might be interested in my other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/181358142?tab=user+files]Mods[/url]

If you appreciate my work could you buy me a coffee [url=https://ko-fi.com/kanacane]Ko fi[/url] ?
